purpose: Lightweight ledger for exact-parity residuals that automated divergence detection (scripts/lib/oracle-divergences.js) does not explain. See docs/architecture/audits/2026-07-31_EXACT_PARITY_REFOCUS.md. Distinct from docs/adjudication/DIVERGENCE_REGISTER.md, which is reserved for authority-classified, style-family-scoped design decisions.

states.citeproc-correct: The oracle is right; Citum has a defect. Counts toward the exact-parity gate as a required fix. An agent may record this state unilaterally.
states.unclear: Neither side's correctness is established from available evidence. Excluded from the exact-parity gate denominator until resolved. An agent may record this state unilaterally, but it escalates to the user for adjudication -- it is not a terminal classification.
states.citum-correct: Citum is right and the oracle (citeproc-js) is wrong or not authoritative for this case. Excluded from the exact-parity gate. Requires "authority" (a cited source: publisher rules, biblatex prior art, a spec section, documentary evidence) and "confirmedBy" (the user). An agent must never write this state; check-core-quality.js rejects citum-correct entries missing either field.
